callablePolicy.supported: async functions, arity1, nonconstructible like Node; invalid source iteration follows the built-in for-await semantics
callablePolicy.deferred: ordinary named functions, arity1, throw ERR_SM_NODE_UNSUPPORTED synchronously on call and construction; this intentionally differs from Node async-function shape

inputPolicy: Plain sync/async iterables; strings or undefined/fixed unshared ArrayBuffer/ArrayBufferView chunks. No Web reader adapter or installed classic Stream API. Shared/resizable/detached backing remains outside the prototype.
deviations: This is not a schema-valid selected production manifest: the coordinator must assign an optional profile version and integrate finite native bindings after gates.
No Node24 bytes export, stream/iter module, classic Stream support or nextTick queue is introduced.
Node global Blob equals node:buffer.Blob; the current selected profile's Buffer.Blob is a deferred function distinct from its native global Blob. No identity parity is claimed.
Resource-limit errors are profile RangeErrors with ERR_SM_NODE_LIMIT. Early cap rejection closes the iterator; Node has no matching small profile limits.
The decoded output cap limits strings before JSON parsing; no exact cap on parser heap/object count or genuine OOM guarantee is claimed.
Direct SharedArrayBuffer is rejected as an invalid BufferSource by this prototype; shared-backed views are explicitly unsupported. No shared-memory data is read.
Error text/stacks and arbitrary application primordial mutations outside the captured dependencies are not a complete Node contract.
Native guest behavior, snapshot/resumption, iterator cancellation and zero emitted imports require a later real component gate.
